# umami_team (Data Source)

Look up an Umami team the authenticated user belongs to, by ID or by name, with its members.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "umami_team" "client" {
  name = "Example Client"
}

output "client_viewers" {
  value = [for m in data.umami_team.client.members : m.username if m.role == "team-view-only"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID (UUID) of the team. One of `id` or `name` is required.
- `name` (String) Name of the team, matched exactly. One of `id` or `name` is required.

### Read-Only

- `access_code` (String, Sensitive) Code that users can enter to join the team.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `members` (Attributes List) Members of the team, including its owner. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `role` (String) Role of the user in the team.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user.
- `username` (String) Username of the user.
